brief: 6 infra tools every serious solo operator runs in 2026 — no bloat, no lock-in.

slots.subtitle: A ruthlessly minimal stack for builders who own their pipeline without surrendering to platform tax or vendor drift.

slots.title: SELF HOSTED
slots.subtitle: Deploy any repository to your own metal in minutes without the pricing surprises of managed platforms.
slots.bodyText: Coolify abstracts Docker orchestration behind a clean UI. You push code; it builds containers, manages SSL, and handles rolling restarts on hardware you control. It replaces Heroku, Render and Vercel with zero platform tax.
slots.calloutBody: Owning the deployment layer means you can migrate providers in an afternoon, not a quarter.

slots.title: S3 COMPATIBLE
slots.subtitle: Keep object storage on your own cluster with the same API your applications already speak.
slots.bodyText: MinIO exposes a high-performance S3 endpoint locally or on any VPS. Your app code requires zero changes to migrate away from AWS, and you retain complete custody of user data and backups.
slots.calloutBody: Data gravity is the ultimate lock-in; keeping blobs local preserves exit velocity.

slots.title: AUTO HTTPS
slots.subtitle: Terminate TLS, route subdomains, and compress responses with a configuration file so small it fits in a tweet.
slots.bodyText: Caddy provisions certificates automatically, handles reverse proxying to containers, and reloads without dropping connections. For a solo operator, it eliminates the need for a separate load balancer or certificate manager.
slots.calloutBody: If your edge layer cannot be versioned in Git, you do not truly own your infrastructure.

slots.title: PRIVATE
slots.subtitle: Connect every node you own into a single encrypted fabric without relying on a third-party control plane.
slots.bodyText: Headscale is an open-source implementation of the Tailscale protocol that you host yourself. Your laptop, server, and phone become one flat network, making internal APIs unreachable to the public internet by default.
slots.calloutBody: A control plane you do not operate is a VPN you do not control.

slots.title: OPEN SOURCE
slots.subtitle: Correlate logs, metrics, and alerts in one dashboard instead of paying SaaS observability rent every month.
slots.bodyText: Grafana ingests Prometheus metrics and Loki logs to surface exactly what is failing and why. You define the retention rules, the alert thresholds, and the sources, so your operational data never leaves your perimeter.
slots.calloutBody: You cannot debug what you cannot see, and you should not outsource your vision.

slots.title: INFRA AS
slots.subtitle: Version your entire stack in plain text and rebuild from zero in any region with a single command.
slots.bodyText: OpenTofu provisions servers, networks, and DNS records through declarative files stored in Git. When your provider changes pricing or policy, you lift the state file and land exactly the same architecture elsewhere within the hour.
slots.calloutBody: Clicking in a dashboard is technical debt; code is the only documentation that survives.

slots.ctaBody: Start with the component that hurts most today. Momentum beats perfection.
